mayor_rejections_for_round3: Gemini's claimed measured 4.5us facade / 450us CUPTI overhead and zero active-serving jitter are unsupported constants, not measurements.
Falsifying one decode-progress coefficient interpretation does not prove a unique roofline model or refute every fluid or linear model.
A fitted mean batch law is not a certified native lower envelope or capacity ceiling.
Output-progress ratios are effective commit-rate observations unless actual batch participation and sampling boundaries are qualified.
Equal whole-episode Fixed16/Fixed32 scores do not prove that a switching budget policy cannot improve.
Rare first-action disagreements do not by frequency alone bound their goodput impact.
Retrospective unresolved-tail score intervals are not an online admission policy.
